Hi Oliver,

Thanks again for applying and for the great conversation in our screen last week. We’d like to schedule the onsite loop for the Senior Infrastructure SWE role. Proposed slot: Thursday, Sep 16 at 15:00 UTC (45m system design, 45m infra deep-dive, 30m wrap).

Please find attached your resume we have on file (oliver_chen_resume.pdf). I’ve cc’d Marcus (infra hiring manager) and Monica (recruiter) — they’ll coordinate panel details and interview invites.

If that time doesn’t work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll try to accommodate. We expect in-person or remote via Google Meet — we’ll send a calendar invite after you confirm.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin (and team),

Really appreciate the quick turnaround. I’m afraid I have an unexpected dental surgery scheduled tomorrow afternoon and my dentist said I should avoid anything strenuous for 48 hours. I won’t be in shape for a multi-panel loop on Thu the 16th.

Would you be open to either:
- moving to the following week (any day Mon/Tue pref), or
- sending a short take-home design exercise I can complete over the weekend and submit by Monday afternoon?

I can do a shorter live call (30m) if absolutely needed, but the take-home would let me demonstrate system thought clearly.

Apologies for the disruption — I still very much want to proceed.

Best,
Oliver Chen
(he/him)

We can absolutely accommodate a take-home to avoid pushing the loop out. Marcus, Laura: would either of you be able to review a take-home submission on Mon 20th? If not, we can still push the live loop to Tue/Wed next week.

Oliver — I’ve attached a short take-home prompt (takehome-instructions.pdf). Deadline: Mon Sep 20 23:59 UTC. Expect ~3 hours of work; we ask for a high-level design + one architecture diagram and a short note on tradeoffs. If you’d prefer a quick 30m sync instead, let me know and we’ll propose slots.

Attachments: takehome-instructions.pdf
